'''Botajef''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], known for its shipyards.

==Description==
Botajef was the location of [[Botajef Shipyards/Legends|Botajef Shipyards]] where [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighters]] were built. Botajef's southern continent was covered in ship-manufacturing facilities where designs such as the AA-9 were designed, built and tested. Huge 325-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] elevator cables stretched from the surface of the world to the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] yards.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
[[Natasi Daala]] grew up on Botajef,<ref name="Blog5">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref> in a [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] orphanage run by [[Renatasian]] nuns.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' was sabotaged by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] during a cruise from [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] to Botajef.<ref name="HONSBS">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>

A [[Battle of Botajef (Imperial Period)|battle]] occurred above Botajef in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Ciutric Offensive]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[127 ABY]] it was the site of the [[Battle of Botajef]], where the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]-aligned [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] fought against the [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Fel Empire]].<ref name="Legacy41" />
